voice.slideHint: Slide left to cancel, up to keep recording
voice.permissionBody: Zuvo needs your microphone only while you record a voice message. Your browser will ask you to allow it next.
voice.blockedBody: Your browser is blocking the microphone for this site. To record voice messages, allow it in your browser’s settings:

chrome.1: Click the icon to the left of the address bar.

edge.1: Click the lock icon to the left of the address bar.
edge.2: Open Permissions for this site and set Microphone to Allow.

safari.1: Open the Safari menu, then Settings for this website.

iphone.1: Open the Settings app, then Apps, then Safari.
iphone.2: Under Settings for Websites, tap Microphone and choose Allow.
iphone.3: Come back and reload the page.

problems.unsupported: This browser can’t record voice messages.
problems.failed: Couldn’t start the microphone. Try again.
